title: Scope dedicated legacy sales order paging and navigation through controlled read service
description: Stage3 core business workflow integrity. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Reuse ERP405 live existing sales-order menu, enabled identity, exact legacy CustId ownership scope and finite controlled ILegacyBillReadService for this dedicated controller. Scope before count/page/navigation and validate prev/next anchor access; restricted unresolved legacy schema/ownership fails closed and privileged behavior needs live module permission. No extra export grants or legacy Oid/canonical Id inference, no unrestricted fallback.

Preserve dedicated route response projection and ordinary authorized paging/navigation contract using server-owned finite columns, parameterized values and safe page arithmetic; no arbitrary SQL, identifiers or joins. Preserve exact currency/unit/deposit/null amount meaning and ordering. Missing tables/columns has an accurate environment failure, no redirection to canonical records. Canonical order services and reporting retirement gate unchanged.

Real isolated SQL tests with two customers prove list total/page and all navigation directions, foreign/absent anchor, revoked/disabled/no identity/module and malformed/overflow input. Test privileged authorized behavior and dedicated-vs-generic legacy read parity for same authorized records. Unit legacy-read regressions and safe Release/full unit; document actual browser/environment blockers.

ERP405 fixed only BillProc routes; this dedicated api/v2/sales-orders read surface independently leaks foreign customer counts, amounts and identifiers.
